state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. "TX". Provide this and/or countyCode. If both are empty, Texas is used.

countyCode.title: County FIPS code
countyCode.description: 5-digit county FIPS code, e.g. "48201" for Harris County, TX. Provide this and/or state.

yearOfLossFrom.title: Year of loss, from
yearOfLossFrom.description: Only include claims with a loss year at or after this year. Leave blank for all years.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of claims to return, most recent loss first.
